annotations.title: Export a data layer to a file

description: Research data export: pull a whole data layer (optionally clipped to a bbox and filtered) to a downloadable GeoJSON or CSV file, returning a presigned URL plus a small preview and the row count. Use list_datasets first to see layers/filters. Big layers (e.g. drillholes, 3.46M) require a bbox. This is the way to get bulk data out for your own analysis — the point tools (inspect_point/get_geochem) only summarise around a point.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] lon/lat clip (required for huge layers).

layer.description: One of the layers from list_datasets.

limit.description: Cap the rows (<= the layer's max).

name: export_data
title: Export a data layer to a file
